thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — prepping the cost section for Halcyon QBR (next Tue). Want to surface: onboarding progress, current embed vs activation spend, and any upcoming renewal risk tied to spikes. @Ethan / @Ravi can you confirm the 30/60/90 day spend trend?
Ethan: pulling numbers now, should have a quick snapshot in a few mins. saw a mid-January embed spike but may be one-off. :mag_right:
Ravi: FYI sales flagged that Halcyon is evaluating a 10% seat expansion at renewal; we should show expected token delta and mitigation levers.
Maya: good — please add that to the QBR appendix. Also need a short list of enablement asks we can send them pre-QBR (playbooks, prompt tuning session, cost guardrails).
Ethan: snapshot: ``30d: 1.2M tokens, 60d: 3.1M tokens, 90d: 4.5M tokens``. Embed calls = ~62% of total cost last 90d. Recommend: 1) enable prefix caching, 2) 8-bit quant profile for embedding model, 3) conservative batching policy.
Nora: capturing enablement items — can run a 45-min prompt tuning workshop and provide a one-pager on batching + cache. I can own sending the invite and prep docs.
Ravi: for renewal risk narrative, propose we show 3 scenarios: conservative (no expansion), expected (+10% seats), upside (+25% seats) and per-scenario unit cost after suggested optimizations.
Maya: perfect. Ethan — can you estimate per-scenario monthly spend with and without optimizations? Even ballpark is fine for QBR.
Ethan: will post numbers in thread by EOD. Quick note: account-bot flagged two budget alerts last week for daily spend > 120% threshold (2025-02-10 and 2025-02-12). Logging that in the QBR risk slide.
account-bot: Alert: Halcyon exceeded daily spend threshold on 2025-02-10 (128%) and 2025-02-12 (135%). Suggested actions: enable threshold-based throttling or notify AE to confirm activity.
Maya: thanks all — action items: Ethan to drop scenario numbers, Nora to prepare enablement deck, Ravi to add renewal expansion note, Maya to assemble slides and send draft Friday. If any objections ping here. :thumbsup:
